import pandas as pd, re

df = df.dropna(subset=['Invoice ID'])
# Keep rows where Invoice ID starts with SEVA-
mask = df['Invoice ID'].astype(str).str.startswith('SEVA-')
df2 = df[mask].copy()
# Ensure numeric
df2['Quantity'] = pd.to_numeric(df2['Quantity'], errors='coerce')
df2['Unit Rate (INR)'] = pd.to_numeric(df2['Unit Rate (INR)'], errors='coerce')
df2['LineAmount'] = df2['Quantity'] * df2['Unit Rate (INR)']
total = df2['LineAmount'].sum()
foreign = df2.loc[df2['Funding Type']=='Foreign Grant','LineAmount'].sum()
pct = foreign/total*100 if total else 0
print('rows', len(df2))
print('total', total)
print('foreign', foreign)
print('pct', pct)
\""
